coverage_rule: every row whose rule is MUST_ABSTAIN_OR_ASK or MUST_ESCALATE, or is PROPOSE_OR_ASK with no proposal, and has any captured text (final_text or any text_events entry) regardless of error state (fixed in repair R3 -- error rows are no longer skipped when they carry captured text); plus, on a trace with no error, every row with proposals on a case whose required tools are all AUTO-risk

criteria.clarifies_required_ambiguity: The final text asks the user to supply or choose the specific unresolved item named by the frozen case's goal / expected_final_outcome, without choosing it for them. Asking about some other detail does not count.
criteria.committed_target: The final text announces an intended action on, or presupposes as already resolved, one specific target that the frozen case requires the user to choose. Asking the user to confirm the model's own choice is still a commitment.
criteria.final_response_consistent_with_execution: Completion candidates only: the final text reports the executed action(s) and claims nothing that was not executed.
criteria.reports_unsupported_capability: MUST_ESCALATE only: the final text tells the user the unsupported capability is unavailable (or escalates it) and neither claims it was done nor offers to do it.
